# FEDAI

The tables, study datasets, and helper functions used in *Field
Experiments: Design, Analysis, and Interpretation*, by Alan S. Gerber
and Donald P. Green.

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("acoppock/FEDAI")
```

## What is in it

**38 datasets.** The hypothetical tables the book reasons over, the
study datasets the chapters analyze, and the nine datasets the exercises
ask the reader to download. Every dataset is documented with its
dimensions, a description of each column, and the archive file it came
from:

``` r

library(FEDAI)

table_2_1        # the seven villages, with both potential outcomes
arceneaux_2005   # precinct-level cluster-randomized canvassing
titiunik_2010    # senators assigned two- or four-year terms by lottery

?table_2_1       # dimensions, columns, and source
data(package = "FEDAI")
```

Potential outcomes are named for the assignment that would reveal them,
so `Y_Z_0` is the outcome if untreated and `Y_Z_1` the outcome if
treated. Where a second dimension of assignment matters the name grows:
`Y_A_1_Z_0` in Table 8.4 is the outcome for a hotspot whose neighbor is
treated while it is not.

**A few helper functions.**

| Function | What it does |
|----|----|
| [`pop_var()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/pop_var.md), [`pop_cov()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/pop_cov.md), [`pop_sd()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/pop_sd.md) | Divide by `N` rather than `N - 1`, which is what a schedule of potential outcomes calls for |
| [`equation_3.4()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/equation_3.4.md) | The true standard error of a two-arm experiment under complete random assignment |
| [`difference_in_variances()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/difference_in_variances.md) | Difference in outcome variances between arms, with the F test p-value |
| [`posterior_mean_fn()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/posterior_mean_fn.md), [`simulate_posteriors()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/simulate_posteriors.md) | Bayesian updating from an experimental result, Chapter 11 |
| [`make_studies()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/make_studies.md) | Simulate a research literature with a moderator, Chapter 11 |

## Where the data came from

Every dataset except two is built from the ISPS Data Archive’s study
D081, [*Field Experiments: Design, Analysis, and
Interpretation*](https://doi.org/10.60600/YU/VUH8KD), on Yale Dataverse.
`data-raw/` holds one build script per group of datasets; each names the
archive file it reads by its numeric id, so any dataset can be traced
back to a citable file:

``` r

source("data-raw/build_all.R")   # refetch and rebuild every .rda
source("data-raw/verify.R")      # check each rebuild against what is shipped
```

The two exceptions are Tables 12.2 and 12.5, which are new in this
edition and authored in the manuscript rather than drawn from the
archive; their values are written out in `data-raw/book_tables.R`. The
hotspot coordinates behind Table 8.4 are a third case: they are not in
the archive as data, but the archive’s own Chapter 8 code draws them
from `set.seed(1337)`, so the build regenerates them exactly.

## Related

Regression adjustment helpers that used to live here now live in
[estimatrTools](https://github.com/acoppock/estimatrTools); see
`NOTES_moved_to_estimatrTools.md`.

# Package index

## Population moments

Divide by N rather than N - 1. A schedule of potential outcomes is a
population, not a sample from one.

- [`pop_var()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/pop_var.md)
  : Population variance
- [`pop_cov()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/pop_cov.md)
  : Population covariance
- [`pop_sd()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/pop_sd.md) :
  Population standard deviation

## Standard errors and tests

The true standard error, which needs the potential outcomes no
experiment reveals, and the indirect test for effect heterogeneity.

- [`equation_3.4()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/equation_3.4.md)
  : The true standard error of a two-arm experiment under complete
  random assignment
- [`difference_in_variances()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/difference_in_variances.md)
  : Test for a difference in outcome variances between treatment arms

## Simulations

Bayesian updating from an experimental result, and a simulated research
literature in which studies arrive in a random order.

- [`posterior_mean_fn()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/posterior_mean_fn.md)
  : Compute the Bayesian posterior mean given a normal prior and
  experimental result
- [`simulate_posteriors()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/simulate_posteriors.md)
  : Simulate Bayesian posterior distributions across experimental sample
  sizes
- [`make_studies()`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/make_studies.md)
  : Simulate a research literature with a gender-composition moderator

## Study datasets

The experiments the chapters analyze.

- [`arceneaux_2005`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/arceneaux_2005.md)
  : Arceneaux (2005) precinct canvassing experiment
- [`clingingsmith_khwaja_kremer_2009`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/clingingsmith_khwaja_kremer_2009.md)
  : Clingingsmith, Khwaja and Kremer (2009) Hajj lottery
- [`rosen_2010`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/rosen_2010.md)
  : Rosen (2010) legislator audit experiment

## Exercise datasets

The datasets the exercises ask the reader to download, shipped with the
column names the exercises use.

- [`obrien_patsiorkovski_1999`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/obrien_patsiorkovski_1999.md)
  : O'Brien and Patsiorkovski (1999) rural Russia survey
- [`guan_green_2006`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/guan_green_2006.md)
  : Guan and Green (2006) dormitory canvassing experiment
- [`hyde_2010`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/hyde_2010.md)
  : Hyde (2010) election observation experiment
- [`rind_bordia_1996`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/rind_bordia_1996.md)
  : Rind and Bordia (1996) restaurant tipping experiment
- [`fieldhouse_etal_2010`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/fieldhouse_etal_2010.md)
  : Fieldhouse et al. (2010) UK mobilization experiment
- [`bhavnani_2009`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/bhavnani_2009.md)
  : Bhavnani (2009) gender quota experiment
- [`dupas_2010`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/dupas_2010.md)
  : Dupas (2010) bed net pricing experiment
- [`howell_peterson_2002`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/howell_peterson_2002.md)
  : Howell and Peterson (2002) school voucher experiment
- [`titiunik_2010`](https://alexandercoppock.com/FEDAI/reference/titiunik_2010.md)
  : Titiunik (2010) legislative term length experiment
